answers.text: "2.7% under the 20-day high is no trigger." Agreed, the pivot has not broken: that is why I file WAIT. Weekly closes above EMA9>21, 11.1% over its last swing high; `structure` 74.7 BULLISH_BOS and the LEADER read hold on D. `mp` 80.0 decelerating costs conviction; `flow` 59.2 is advisory to me.

"Distance above ma_200 is not distance from the high." Not my test. R7: entry 22.14 is 76.6% above `ma_200` 12.54, past the 70% climax line; `subcomponents.structure.base_score` 0.0 is no base, so no pivot (R3); day_vol 0.51 fails R4. A daily 0.8% over the swing high is a spike.

"base_score 0.0 and far above ma_200 are no faults." Base is my gate: `subcomponents.structure.base_score` 0.0 means no completed base and nothing downstream rescues it (R3). `subcomponents.flow.cmf` 0.29 and `structure` 81.1 are real, but they are the run itself.

"no coil or test prints 2.2% under the high." Coil is timing; my test is base soundness: `structure` 94.7, `subcomponents.structure.base_score` 15.0, LEADER, W 0.6% over swing high. Fair hit: `subcomponents.energy.squeeze_score` 0.0 shows no tightness (R3), so WAIT, not a buy.

"'Not stretched' fails: my blind ext_atr20 3.8." ext_atr20 is an ATR-from-mean read, not mine. C17 measures from the pivot: close 2.4% UNDER the 20-day high, W and D HH/HL; R7 sma_dist 13.75% is far from 70%. `mp` 100.0 and `structure` 84.2 stand; zero squeeze keeps it WAIT.
